name: John Deere Dubuque Works - Dubuque IA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Mile-long plant on a 1,465-acre tract; reached by a long internal access road with multiple roundabouts off S John Deere Rd. Multi-lane managed entries at the building edge are inferred from the campus scale and layout; exact gate hardware not resolved (no Street View past the property edge).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth resolved at entries in available satellite imagery.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set as the corollary of an inferred gate with no resolved booth; low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs the full length of the property along the east (riverside) edge, confirmed in z18-20 imagery near the wastewater ponds.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large riverside trailer drop yard holds 50+ trailers in rows; a second material/finished-equipment marshaling yard sits south of it.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~30 truck dock positions estimated across the mile-long building's east face; exact count not resolvable from overhead imagery and finished construction equipment also ships drive-away / on rail.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: The complex spans over a mile with distinct east-face loading clusters at multiple building sections, implying separated shipping and receiving operations.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~480 acres for the developed/fenced industrial footprint; the full Deere tract is 1,465 acres including buffer woodland and farmland.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — isolated riverbottom plant SW of Dubuque surrounded by farmland, woods, and Mississippi backwater.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Vast paved aprons and wide internal roads leave abundant room for added or express truck lanes.
